allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Integra Essentia Limited has informed the Exchange about Outcome of Rights Issue Committee

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Integra Essentia Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 14, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 161 : 250, i.e 161 Equity Shares for every 250 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 145 per share.
